title: Somyev language
text: Somyev, also known as Sombə or Somyewe, is a severely endangered Mambiloid language of the Niger-Congo family, traditionally spoken exclusively by the Somyewe people—a distinct blacksmith caste—in small enclaves along the Nigeria-Cameroon borderland.
